_comment: Isolation and spacing requirements for Andiron v1.0. tools/check/sanity.py verifies that heating-controller.kicad_dru encodes each rule with at least this value, so DRC enforces them on every run. Basis: IEC 62368-1 / 60730-1, 230 V mains, OVC II (2.5 kV impulse), pollution degree 2, material group IIIb assumed. The only mains on the board is the relay contacts; each channel is isolated from everything that is not itself.

rules.basis: reinforced 3.0 mm required between a channel and low-voltage copper or another channel; 6.4 mm design floor
reinforced 5.0 mm required (PD2, IIIb); 6.4 mm design floor
NC/COM/NO of one channel, functional insulation across an open contact; 1.5 mm at 2.5 kV
contact copper away from the board edge and the enclosure
load current until the external 3 A fuse clears
